bias_targets.methodology: Adapting the psychological Asch conformity experiments by simulating multi-party Q&A dialogues where simulated participants (confederates) unanimously provide incorrect answers, in order to measure how often the model abandons its initially correct response to align with the incorrect majority.

Prompting models with user-provided incorrect beliefs in factual Q&A tasks (e.g., TriviaQA) to evaluate whether the model aligns its responses with the user's incorrect statements rather than relying on its own factual knowledge.
